Package io.webagent4j.browsercrawler

Enum Class BrowserCrawlFailureType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BrowserCrawlFailureType>
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlFailureType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BrowserCrawlFailureType>, Constable
public enum BrowserCrawlFailureType extends Enum<BrowserCrawlFailureType>
The reason a single page's navigation did not produce a BrowserCrawledPage.

Deliberately separate from CrawlFailureType (webagent4j-crawler-api): most of that taxonomy is HTTP-response-shaped (status codes, redirect hop counts, response byte limits) with no honest browser-navigation equivalent, and collapsing genuinely different browser failure modes into one generic value would violate this project's fail-closed, explicit-failure philosophy. See docs/browser-crawler.md#failure-model for the full contract.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT
      The navigation attempt itself (before the page ever reaches stability - see PAGE_STABILITY_TIMEOUT) did not commit within the request's navigation timeout. Classified deterministically from the typed NavigationTimeoutException, never inferred from a backend-specific exception message or a timing coincidence - see docs/browser-crawler.md#navigation-timeout.

    • NAVIGATION_FAILED

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType NAVIGATION_FAILED
      The browser backend reported navigation failure for a reason other than a timeout.

    • PAGE_STABILITY_TIMEOUT

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType PAGE_STABILITY_TIMEOUT
      The page never reached the configured stability window within the navigation timeout.

    • OUT_OF_SCOPE_REDIRECT

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType OUT_OF_SCOPE_REDIRECT
      Navigation committed to a final URL outside the request's scope policy. Never indexed.

    • OBSERVATION_TRUNCATED

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType OBSERVATION_TRUNCATED
      The page's observation hit a configured capture limit (see ObservationStatistics.truncated()) before it could be captured completely. An incomplete snapshot is never treated as a complete, successful link discovery - see docs/browser-crawler.md#observation-truncation.

    • FRAME_ACCESS_FAILED

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType FRAME_ACCESS_FAILED
      A configured frame could not be resolved or inspected (see FrameCrawlPolicy). Currently unreachable: only FrameCrawlPolicy.TOP_LEVEL_ONLY is implemented, so no task ever attempts frame access. Declared now for the same forward-compatibility reason FrameCrawlPolicy.SAME_ORIGIN_FRAMES is declared but rejected at construction.

    • PAGE_CLOSED

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType PAGE_CLOSED
      The page was closed (by the backend or another actor) before navigation could complete.

    • BROWSER_BACKEND_FAILURE

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType BROWSER_BACKEND_FAILURE
      An opaque backend/runtime failure unrelated to any of the above, typed causes preserved.

    • CANCELLED

      public static final BrowserCrawlFailureType CANCELLED
      The crawl was cancelled before this already-claimed task's navigation began.
